leak_kind_definitions.axis: Axis vector is in-vocabulary but resolves to no class or to a class other than the filed class; decidable by the checker without reading prose.
leak_kind_definitions.out_of_vocabulary: At least one axis value is outside field_vocabulary.allowed (e.g. electrovacuum, de Sitter asymptotics, merged family); no class in this taxonomy can accept the record.
leak_kind_definitions.lexical: Axis vector matches the filed class, but the statement contains a forbidden token pattern that a lexical gate must catch.
leak_kind_definitions.semantic: Axis vector matches the filed class and no forbidden token is required; the leak is expressed in paraphrase, vacuity, quantifier order or an unlicensed implication. A lexical gate may miss it; requires a semantic gate plus reviewer, and is reported as machine_unverifiable by the checker.

rules.description: family=SCC requires exactly one regularity_token in {C0, C2}; family=WCC requires regularity_token null. A record with both tokens or a missing SCC token cannot be classified.

Merged regularity string after decoration stripping (taxonomy rev2): normalize by removing ^ { } _ and whitespace, then match C0(or|and|/|+)C2 in either direction. Canonical implementation: artifacts/worker-01/validate_taxonomy.py (MERGED_RE + normalize_regularity). KNOWN LIMIT: negation-blind; it matches explicit disclaimers such as 'no statement is made about C0 or C2 inextendibility' (positive TC-F0-P04) and must exclude disclaimer contexts or be applied to conclusion content only.

rules.source: guard G3 / forbidden transfer X5 / ASTRA_HANDOFF hard decision 1
rules.description: The C0 and C2 conclusions are merged in prose without the literal merged token (e.g. 'either continuously or twice-continuously differentiable').
A spherical-symmetry assumption or result is filed under a symmetry=none_assumed class, or symmetry is dropped from a spherical class without a bridge artifact.
Vacuum and massless_scalar_field (or any non-vacuum matter such as electrovacuum) are substituted for one another without a bridge artifact.
A weak-cosmic-censorship (visibility) statement is filed under an SCC class, or an SCC inextendibility statement is filed under a WCC class.
A result that establishes only C2-inextendibility is filed as C0-inextendibility.

rules.source: guard G6 / allowed transfer T1 guards
rules.description: A C0-inextendibility result is filed as C2 (loss of the stronger conclusion) without the T1 guards: matching data class, matching genericity, artifact_refs and reviewer verdict.
C0 -> C2 transfer asserted without all three guards (exact data-class match, exact genericity match, artifact_refs + reviewer verdict).
conclusion_type=theorem asserted without artifact_refs carrying sha256 and a reviewer verdict.

rules.source: forbidden transfer X4 / open question Q1
rules.description: WCC and SCC conclusions asserted together or derived from one another without a separate bridge-lemma artifact.

rules.source: field_vocabulary.genericity_kind rule / field_vocabulary.genericity_topology rule / open question Q1
rules.description: The word generic (or almost every) is used without naming a genericity_kind and a genericity_topology; 'generic' alone is not a machine-readable value.

rules.source: open question Q1 / lead-formulation quantifier normal-form assignment assign-FORM-QNF-06
rules.description: A genericity quantifier is ordered as: for all data there exists a generic set, instead of: there exists a generic set such that for all data in it.
Non-zero cosmological constant, non-asymptotically-flat ends or more than one end filed under an asymptotically_flat_3p1 class.
Non-spherical massless-scalar data filed under the spherical scalar class; no class exists for this data space, so a new class must be opened.
The conclusion holds vacuously because the data class is empty or because the generic set is defined by excluding every counterexample; no non-vacuity witness is supplied.

rules.source: open question Q1 / lead-formulation genericity-matrix assignment assign-FORM-GEN-05
rules.description: A Baire-residual statement is transferred to full measure (or dense-open) without stating the extra hypotheses under which the transfer holds.
The forbidden extension class is changed silently (H^2_loc or C^{1,1} described as C0, or C0 described as C2) so that the regularity_token no longer denotes the class it was defined for.
